summary: Gave verify-deploy.sh's Gate 8 a three-way verdict (pass/warn_advisory/fail) driven by run-all.sh's own --fail-on-new EXPECTED/NEW accounting, so an all-declared-expected failing run is non-blocking and visible rather than a bare FAIL while a NEW failure still blocks unconditionally. Added a 22-assertion fixture regression suite, a roster-header format-stability pin, consumer re-verification (deploy_findings_snapshot, --skip-unchanged cache, zero-check-under-filter), documentation of the new semantics and its accepted mixed-failure residual, and redeployed with a scoped --only-gate 3,4,9 verification pass.
